question: What siRNA dose did Gao et al. use in their study?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%Gao%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%mg/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%mg kg%' OR text ILIKE '%dose%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page IN (6,7) AND kind IN ('line') ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 60
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%CL4H6%' OR text ILIKE '%CL4%' OR text ILIKE '%[55]%' OR text ILIKE '%55]%') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND row_no BETWEEN 1 AND 12 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%FOXM1%' OR text ILIKE '%μg%' OR text ILIKE '%µg%' OR text ILIKE '%nmol%' OR text ILIKE '%mg%' OR text ILIKE '%nM%' OR text ILIKE '%injected%' OR text ILIKE '%dosage%' OR text ILIKE '%per mouse%') ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, table_id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE (table_id IN ('p16.T3','p17.T3') AND col_no=7 AND text ILIKE '%55%') OR (text ILIKE '%FOXM1%') OR (text ILIKE '%PD-1%' AND table_id IN ('p16.T3','p17.T3')) ORDER BY table_id, row_no
